# 1. Dispatch Envoy to Eastern Corridor (12 ports; Trajan's Canal -25% discount; .14 enclave lease option).
oe_far_dec_envoy_east = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_far_roman_host = yes
        oe_far_east_open = yes
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_envoy_east_cd }
        OR = {
            oe_far_any_east_envoy = yes
            oe_far_any_east_lease = yes
        }
        gold >= oe_far_cost_east_press
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_far_dec_envoy_east.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd days = 30 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    oe_far_any_east_envoy = yes
                    gold >= oe_far_cost_east_envoy
                }
                add_gold = oe_far_pay_east_env
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd months = 24 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_job value = 201 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.20
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_far_dec_envoy_east.b
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd days = 30 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    oe_far_any_east_envoy = yes
                    power_projection >= 30
                    gold >= oe_far_cost_east_press
                }
                add_gold = oe_far_pay_east_prs
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd months = 24 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_job value = 202 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.20
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_far_dec_envoy_east.c
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd days = 30 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    oe_far_any_east_lease = yes
                    gold >= oe_far_cost_3y
                }
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_envoy_east_cd months = 36 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_far_job value = 203 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.20
            }
        }
    }
}

# 3. Audit Overseas Exarchs & Roman Company Books (5y cooldown; real cost + 3y trade chill).
oe_far_dec_audit_exarchs = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_far_roman_host = yes
        has_global_variable = oe_far_on
        OR = {
            oe_far_east_open = yes
            oe_far_west_open = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_audit_cd }
        prestige >= 10
        gold >= oe_far_cost_1m
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_auto } global_var:oe_far_auto >= 10 } trigger_else = { always = no }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_far_dec_audit_exarchs.a
        effect = {
            add_prestige = -10
            add_gold = oe_far_pay_1m
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_audit_cd months = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_job value = 221 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.20
        }
    }
}

# 4. Recall & Centralize Overseas Exarchate (available at high autonomy >= 75 or voluntary centralization).
oe_far_dec_recall_exarch = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_far_roman_host = yes
        OR = {
            oe_far_has_east_exarch = yes
            oe_far_has_west_exarch = yes
            any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade }
            any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_recall_cd }
        stability >= 5
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_far_dec_recall_exarch.a
        effect = {
            add_stability = -5
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_recall_cd months = 120 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_far_job value = 231 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_far.20
        }
    }
}
